blocks.text: Collaboration pools knowledge and skills to solve complex problems, and iteration refines work with each step. In community clean-up drives in Pakistan, people plan where to start, then adjust their plans when tasks take longer or more volunteers are needed (iterate), and keep working together (collaborate) until the area is clean. The Indus Valley Civilization showed early collaboration and iteration in its town planning and construction (Did You Know).
